COURT'S OR JUDGES'S ORDERS
WPCRL No.671 of 2025
Hon'ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
Mr. Sharang Dhulia, Advocate for the petitioners, through video
conferencing.
2. Mr. B.C. Joshi, A.G.A. for the State.
3. Mr. Siddhartha Jain, Advocate for respondent no.3.
4. Mr. Navneet Kaushik, Advocate, for respondent no.4, who may
file his vakalatnama, in the matter, during course of the day.
5. By means of this writ petitioner, the petitioners have sought
indulgence of this Court in the nature of certiorari for quashing the
impugned order dated 30.04.2025, by which the order for debit freezing
for account of the petitioners was made.
6. Learned counsel for respondent no.4-complainant informed this
Court that after investigation in the FIR No.0462 of 2022 dated
24.08.2022 registered at Police Station Kotwali Jwalapur, District
Haridwar a charge sheet has been submitted on 28.07.2023. After
submission of charge sheet an application for defreezing of the account
was made to learned I
st Additional District and Sessions Judge, Haridwar.
The learned I
st Additional District and Sessions Judge vide order dated
12.11.2024 rejected that application. Without challenging the said order,
the petitioners cannot maintain the writ petition before this Court. The
right course available to the petitioners would be to challenge the order
dated 12.11.2024 passed by the learned I
st Additional District and
Sessions Judge before appropriate forum in appropriate proceedings
under the law.
7. Accordingly writ petition is dismissed in limine.
